note: The DNS header question count is read from the input packet and controls how much of m->_packet is reserved before parsing question labels.
The input-controlled qdcount advances m->_len inside the fixed m->_packet storage, placing the next decoded label near the end of the stack-resident buffer.
The decoded domain name destination is derived from the advanced m->_len and points to the end of the packet scratch buffer.
The bounds check allows equality with m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN even though the following dot terminator write also needs one byte of space.
For a 63-byte label starting exactly 63 bytes before the end of m->_packet, the separator write lands one byte past the fixed stack buffer.
